categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labels include Tests, and the PR modifies test_framework/p2p.py and test_framework/util.py to replace polling with condition variable notifications.
categories.rationale: The PR delivers a substantial suite-wide speedup by removing polling delays and relay rate-limits in functional tests. Author benchmarks show an 11% reduction in wall time and a 17.5% drop in accumulated CPU time, with reviewer ACKs independently confirming drops in local runtimes.
